summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test of fresh Interiojunction Expo app. 30/30 pytest cases pass against public ingress URL. Frontend mobile flows verified: customer phone OTP (dev_code auto-fill) -> customer home shows seeded projects -> project detail with full stage timeline; AI assistant returns INR-priced kitchen estimate via Emergent LLM; staff login routes admin to operations dashboard with KPIs and project list; factory login routes to Part Scanner and manual-part-input + manual-scan-button advances a part one stage and shows in Recent Scans. Authorization is enforced (customer -> 403 on /scan, /scan/recent, /leads, /dashboard, PATCH /tickets, and only sees own projects). No React Native red screens, no critical errors. Two console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props deprecated and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated — these originate from react-native-web internals, not app code, and can be ignored unless the upstream libs are updated. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch); expo-camera is used for QR scanning (can't be exercised on web — manual fallback validated).

minor.issue: bcrypt 'AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' trapped warning at startup from passlib — harmless but log noise. Pinning passlib[bcrypt] or bcrypt<4 silences it.
Sequence numbering uses count_documents + 41, which collides if a project is deleted/re-created. Not a bug today, just brittle.

On unknown phone with no prior OTP request, returns 400 'Request an OTP first' which is correct; but verify endpoint does not rate-limit by IP — only by attempts on existing record. Low risk because dev mock.

design_issues.screen: Customer home / Factory scanner / Staff dashboard
issues: Touch targets all >=44pt, spacing on 8pt grid, contrast on cream #FDFAF6 + black is strong. No issues observed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Comes from RNW, not app code. Reference: browser console during any screen load.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from RNW, not app code.

action_items: Optional: pin passlib/bcrypt to silence 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' warning (e.g. add 'bcrypt<4' or upgrade passlib).
Optional: harden /api/projects sequence generator (use a counters collection or max(project_code) instead of count_documents + 41) to avoid collisions on delete/re-create.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 485-line file. Still under the 700-line guideline but consider splitting auth / projects / scanner / tickets / leads / ai into routers as it grows.
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id via projection — good.
All endpoints validated with Pydantic models — good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL via src/api.ts wrapper — good.
All interactive elements expose testID (mode tabs, inputs, send/verify buttons, manual scan, project cards, AI send, ticket form). Good coverage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke flows (auth x3 roles, project detail, AI chat, scan, dashboard)

seed_data_creation: Backend seed runs on startup. Pytest additionally created TEST_ prefixed projects (PRJ-2026-044, PRJ-2026-045), TEST_ tickets and TEST_Lead lead. These are visible in the staff dashboard and do not interfere with prod data.
